# Accessibility Reference

Source: Google/design/a11y (CONSENSUS)

## Purpose
WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, contrast, focus visibility, keyboard navigation, and aria attributes.

## Guidelines
1. **Color Contrast**: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and UI components.
2. **Focus Visibility**: Clear, distinct focus indicator (`focus-visible`) on all interactive elements.
3. **Keyboard Navigation**: Logical tab order and keyboard operability for all controls.
4. **ARIA & Labels**: Proper labels on form controls, landmark regions, and status announcements.
